quest.title: Come Play With the Moon
quest.description: Columbina seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. That's odd. Paimon's positive she heard Columbina's voice...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...Hyah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaah!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Another jumpscare? Not cool! If you were here, you should've just said so!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I thought that since you were already so familiar with this game, I should increase the difficulty this round...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Paimon's gonna get you next time, just you wait!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Great! I look forward to it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to your eye mask, Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Oh. I guess the kuuhenki must've swiped it when we were playing earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I don't usually need to use my eyes, so the mask makes little difference. Let them play with it if they like.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! On that note, don't you want to go out more often?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You no longer need to hide from anyone, right?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes... I have plenty of time now. I can go where I wish, when I wish.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: However, I was concerned that you might worry if you came looking for me but found that I had left without saying goodbye.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! After all, we only need to know that you're okay.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: I see. I will consider it, then.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Or maybe this is just where you want to be.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Everything that has happened here... I find them to be happy memories.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: That said, I do have another reason for waiting for you here.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: To give you a pleasant surprise.

choices.text: You can just leave a note.

talks.objective: Head to where the surprise is

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! This must be the place you were talking about, right? Paimon wasn't there last time, so she didn't get to see it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It truly is lovely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can Paimon fly around and check it out?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: If it pleases you, I could bring you back again someday.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, this is the "pleasant surprise," then?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Oh? So this is enough to pass as a "pleasant surprise" in your eyes? No, the real surprise is yet to come.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's more?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Come. Let us paint.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait. Here? But Paimon doesn't see canvas, brushes, or paints anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Oh. That's simple.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: The water's surface is our canvas, the moonlight our brushes, and the paths we take shall serve as the brushstrokes.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: With the moon's reflection to guide us, pure thought shall flow beneath our feet.

talks.objective: Follow the moon's guide and paint the pattern

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Luonnotar! It's really you! You're back! In the silvery flesh! Paimon thought she'd never see you again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The painting we drew...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: We used moonlight to trace this child's form, and I poured new power and new blessings therein, causing her to be reborn.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: She no longer needs to bear my spirit. Her will is hers alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, she's flying over!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes. I have awakened all the memories of the time you spent together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sniff* Paimon's so glad to have you back, Luonnotar. She promises to be nicer to you from now on...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wasn't expecting the surprise to be this pleasant... Paimon loves it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you, Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It wasn't much. I, too, am glad to see her again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (She's still very attached to Luonnotar, but her expression is different from before.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (She looks at Luonnotar not as merely a created familiar, but as a familiar friend.)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Go. You must miss them, surely.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You're welcome to come back any time.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Now, I know how fond you are of them, but let's not cause them any trouble now, alright?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Come back here to rest, should you find yourself tired from playing outside.
